Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the warm welcome yesterday. Attached are the W-9 and our signed PO acceptance. We've also completed the ACH authorization form (attached). Can you confirm what remittance format Redwood expects on your end? Specifically:
- Do we include PO# in the ACH remittance field, or do you require a separate remittance file/CSV?
- Does Redwood perform micro-deposit verification or do you support tokenized EFT (we can provide a tokenized account via our payments partner)?

We want to make sure our first payout matches your invoice/PO mapping so there are no delays.

Files: Pinewave_W9.pdf, ACH_Authorization_Form.pdf, PO_Accepted_signed.pdf

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 09 Sep 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding docs + remittance question

Alex — thanks for sending these over and welcome aboard. Quick answers and next steps below.

1) Upload: Please upload the signed W-9 and ACH auth to our vendor portal here: https://redwood.vendor-portal.com/upload/PNW-8821 (that creates a stable vendor record and kicks off automated validation).

2) Remittance format: Our preferred delivery for remittance is to include PO# in the ACH remitter memo when possible and to also send a remittance CSV via SFTP for the first month. Minimum required remittance fields: PO#, Invoice#, Invoice date, Invoice amount, Remittance contact email.

3) Bank verification: By default we do micro-deposit verification for new accounts (small deposits within 1-2 business days). We can accept tokenized EFT (payments token) as an alternative, but that requires an additional compliance attestation and a short integration step — finance must approve.

4) PO processing: To ensure fast allocation, prefix invoice filenames with the PO number (e.g., PO12345_Invoice001.pdf) and include PO# in the invoice PDF body. Our AP system matches on PO# + invoice number.

Looping in Marissa (Finance) to confirm if tokenized EFT is acceptable in this case and to confirm the remitter alias we should expect. Once the portal upload completes we'll trigger micro-deposit.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
ATTACHMENTS: None (please upload to portal)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Hi Alex / Karthik — noted and thank you for the quick turnaround. A couple of short items from Finance:

- Micro-deposit: Approved as default; we will issue two micro-deposits within 48 business hours after portal validation. Vendor receives two small deposits and confirms amounts.
- Tokenized EFT: We are open to accepting tokenized accounts on a case-by-case basis. For Pinewave we'll need: token provider name, sample token exchange flow, and a completed Vendor payments attestation form. If Pinewave shares that, we can route to our compliance team for a fast-tracked review.
- Remittance alias: "PINEWAVE_FIN" is acceptable. Please include that in the remitter name and put PO# in the remitter memo field. For the onboarding payout, please also send a remittance CSV to sftp.redwood.com:/remit/pinewave with the following columns: po_number,invoicenumber,invoicedate,amount,remit_email.

Marissa will review the uploaded Sample_Invoice_Pinewave.pdf and confirm mapping; Alex, could you also attach a single example invoice that includes PO and invoice number in the PDF text (not only the filename)? That helps automated parsing.

Marissa Cole
Senior Finance Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
